notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
Crystalline Crawler and Cryptic Trilobite have at least one +1/1 counter on them.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking your commander.
Your commander enters the battlefield, triggering Norn's Choirmaster, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
